- **Bacterial_Wilt Bugwood_3 (ID 5606063)**: Stem cross-section showing internal brown vascular discoloration with bacterial streaming — sequential ID.

The internal brown stem discoloration and the context (black plastic mulch, complete plant collapse) are consistent with Bacterial Wilt (*Ralstonia solanacearum*).
